home.seo_p1: At OWNEO we revolutionise the concept of luxury supercar sharing in Spain, making the dream of driving the world's most exclusive vehicles a reality.
home.seo_p1_body: Our exclusive fleet includes the most coveted Ferrari supercars, the power of a Lamborghini or the full Porsche range: the 911 Turbo S, the electric Taycan and the Cayenne and Macan sport SUVs.
home.seo_p2_body: Discover the refinement of the Aston Martin DB11, the aerodynamic innovation of the McLaren 720S, or the supreme luxury of the Rolls-Royce Wraith. Complete your experience with the craftsmanship of the Bentley Continental GT or the power of the Mercedes-AMG GT R, known as 'The Beast of the Green Hell'.
home.seo_footer: From sharing a Ferrari in Barcelona to a Lamborghini in Marbella, OWNEO gives you the opportunity to live unique experiences behind the wheel of the world's finest supercars. Discover why we are leaders in luxury car sharing and supercar experiences in Spain.
home.intro_para: A brand that redefines access to high-end cars through shared ownership: an efficient, modern and aspirational model, aligned with the new way of understanding mobility.

about.title: It's not a car.
about.subtitle: OWNEO was born to break the equation that for decades has kept automotive luxury reserved for a very few.
about.manifesto_title: Luxury shouldn't be a matter of fortune.
about.manifesto_p1: We believe the world's most extraordinary cars shouldn't be reserved for the few. Not for lack of passion, but because of an economic equation that for decades has made automotive luxury unreachable.
about.manifesto_p2: OWNEO was born to break that equation. Not by democratising luxury downwards — but by elevating access upwards. The same car, the same experience, the same emotion. Without the burden of ownership.
about.mission_desc: We want anyone with the right determination and discernment to be able to sit behind the wheel of a Ferrari, a Porsche or a Bentley — without buying it, without managing anything, without surprises.
about.vision_desc: We aspire to build the most exclusive community of motoring enthusiasts in Europe — where access to the world's finest vehicles is an intelligent decision, not an inherited privilege.
about.profile1_hook: Dreamed of a Ferrari since he was 16. OWNEO makes it possible.
about.profile1_text: No need to wait until you have €300,000 in the bank. With an OWNEO participation, that dream has a date, a plate and 4 guaranteed weeks a year.
about.profile2_hook: Doesn't buy impulses. Buys experiences with real value.
about.profile2_text: An OWNEO participation isn't an expense — it's a financial decision with an estimated return, controlled mileage and managed resale. Luxury that also makes sense on a spreadsheet.
about.profile3_title: The one who lives in the present
about.profile3_hook: Prefers 4 weeks behind the wheel of a Porsche over 365 days worrying about it.
about.profile3_text: No garage, no insurance, no services, no paperwork. Just book via the app, pick up an immaculate car and enjoy. The rest is OWNEO's problem.
about.value1_text: Luxury shouldn't be a privilege of the few. What once required a fortune, today requires an intelligent decision.
about.value2_text: Every contract, every delivery, every euro invested is backed by a real commitment. No hidden clauses.
about.value3_text: We don't manage cars. We manage experiences. And in every detail, we demand the best.
about.value4_text: OWNEO members share more than a car. They share a vision of what luxury should mean.
